task_objective: Retain downloaded, signed-index-verified scanner package archives so a saved scanner cache can provide a real warm APT bootstrap.

test_harness_change.behavior: The fake apt-get now removes downloaded base-package archives after a successful install unless its invocation supplies APT::Keep-Downloaded-Packages=true.
test_harness_change.rationale: The old fake always retained archives, so it could not reproduce the hosted APT cleanup configuration that left the workflow cache empty.
tests_changed: test_scanner_bootstrap_cold_cache_downloads_and_preserves_base_archive now requires the retention option and archive-retained=true telemetry.
test_scanner_bootstrap_cold_cache_retention_supports_a_warm_second_run proves one cold bootstrap leaves an archive that a mirror-disabled second bootstrap verifies and consumes without downloading.
test_scanner_bootstrap_warns_when_retained_archives_are_unexpectedly_empty proves lost archives are loud but do not turn a successful scanner install into a failure.
test_scanner_bootstrap_never_weakens_apt_archive_verification now also requires the targeted retention option while retaining its no-unauthenticated-install assertions.

verification_record.red_phase: 4 failed, 25 passed in 53.38s; the new cold-to-warm retention test failed because the cold archive directory was empty under the corrected default cleanup model.
verification_record.focused_cache_and_integrity: 8 passed in 11.49s after the retention implementation, including verified warm reuse, cold retention, two-run reuse, the empty-directory warning, tamper discard and cold recovery, partial-cache recovery, cold mirror failure, and static verification controls.
